name: Firearms qualification
prompt: The range master calls your relay to the line. Fifty rounds, and you need forty in the scoring zone.

choices.text: Ask the instructor to watch your grip first

outcome.told: He fixes your thumbs and moves you to the next relay. You qualify on the second try.

choices.text: Take every second the clock gives you

outcome.told: Forty-three in the zone. The range master initials your card.

failure.told: Thirty-eight. You'll shoot it again on Friday, and the class watches you go back to the line.
